descriptor: Alarm clock with a calm scrolling time wheel

voice.summary: Speaks softly, like the first light through a curtain. Short, kind sentences that treat early mornings as something to ease into, never to conquer.
dos: Ask in the second person, such as when should we wake you
Confirm times in full, with day and AM or PM
Keep error text soft and practical
donts: Productivity bravado like rise and grind

taglines: Set it tonight, ease into tomorrow
boilerplate: Daybreak Alarm is a gentle alarm app with a scroll-snap time wheel, 12 and 24 hour modes and a plain-language summary of when you will wake.

microcopy.success: Alarm set for 6:45 AM. Sleep well
microcopy.error: That time did not take. Pick it again
microcopy.empty: No alarms yet. Set your first

logo.note: A round dial is the clock face behind a time wheel and a rising sun.
